{{Top|canon=Spice dealer}}
[[File:Merchantofdeathsticks-EotECR.png|thumb|230px|A merchant of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]]]
A '''drug dealer''' was any person of any species who sold or trafficked [[Spice/Legends|drugs]].

==History==
[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] posed as [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah's]] drug dealer in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] as part of a law enforcement operation.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Wendell Wright-Sims]], a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] socialite, was [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center's]] most prominent spice dealer.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Fargednim P'taan]] was a mid-level drug dealer on [[Yetoom Na Uun]].<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
